spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Lily Pond
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. Pin moved to Lily Pond Beach on the shore.

spots.name: Beech Mountain Lookout
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented. Mapped as private or no access: check before you go.

spots.name: Anemone Cave
spots.tip: A cave entrance. Bring a headlamp and a tripod; light from the opening makes the picture. Check whether it's closed for bats or ice. Mapped as private or no access: check before you go.
